article.headline: Benigni's 24 help Navy upset Bucknell 83-77 in Patriot League Tournament semifinals
article.description: — Austin Benigni had 24 points in fifth-seeded Navy's 83-77 upset over top-seeded Bucknell on Sunday in the Patriot League Tournament.
article.linkText: Benigni's 24 help Navy upset Bucknell 83-77 in Patriot League Tournament semifinals
article.story: LEWISBURG, Pa. -- — Austin Benigni had 24 points in fifth-seeded Navy's 83-77 upset over top-seeded Bucknell on Sunday in the Patriot League Tournament. Navy will play for the championship at the winner of the third-seeded Colgate vs. second-seeded American for the championship on Wednesday. Benigni also had seven assists for the Midshipmen (15-18). Jordan Pennick scored 15 points, going 4 of 10 from the floor, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line. Jinwoo Kim shot 4 of 5 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the line to finish with 13 points. Noah Williamson led the way for the Bison (18-15) with 22 points, seven rebounds and four blocks. Achile Spadone added 21 points and three steals for Bucknell. Josh Bascoe also had 16 points and three steals. The Bison broke a five-game winning streak with the loss. Kim put up nine points in the first half for Navy, who led 36-33 at halftime. Benigni scored 22 points down the stretch in the second half to help lead Navy to a six-point victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
